title: <Org> umbrella integration
description: Declares how a project's documentation site appears in the organisation umbrella at https://<org>.github.io/.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema pointer, ignored by the aggregator.

name.description: Display name for the project. Defaults to the project manifest name, then the repository name.

description.description: One-line summary shown on the project card.

docs_url.description: Absolute URL of the project's documentation site.

category.description: Optional grouping label, used as a section heading when present.

order.description: Optional sort weight; lower values are listed first.
